blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte may be called to the witness stand by the House prosecution panel on the 30th day of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Mayor Duterte is expected to testify on the vice president’s supposed unexplained wealth after Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) Electronic Government Procurement Operations Division chief Rendell Sopeña completes his examination. Sopeña’s cross-examination will open the trial day after the House prosecution wrapped up its direct examination the previous week. The PhilGEPS executive testified that 49 food service contracts worth P35 million were awarded by Davao Region […]...
